name: data-database-dmloptions-runtime

args: Database.DMLOptions opts=new Database.DMLOptions(); opts.optAllOrNone=false; opts.allowFieldTruncation=false; System.assertEquals(false,opts.optAllOrNone); Object single=new Account(Name='Single'); Database.SaveResult s1=Database.insert(single,opts); System.assert(s1.isSuccess()); Account singleRow=[SELECT Id,Name FROM Account WHERE Id=:s1.getId()]; System.assertEquals('Single',singleRow.Name); Object singleAccess=new Account(Name='Single Access'); Database.SaveResult s2=Database.insert(singleAccess,opts,AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(s2.isSuccess()); List<Object> listRows=new List<Object>{new Account(Name='List A'),new Account(Name='List B')}; List<Database.SaveResult> s3=Database.insert(listRows,opts); System.assertEquals(2,s3.size()); System.assert(s3[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(s3[1].isSuccess()); List<Object> listAccessRows=new List<Object>{new Account(Name='List Access A'),new Account(Name='List Access B')}; List<Database.SaveResult> s4=Database.insert(listAccessRows,opts,AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2,s4.size()); System.assert(s4[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(s4[1].isSuccess()); Object updateObject=new Account(Id=s1.getId(),Name='Single Updated'); Database.SaveResult u1=Database.update(updateObject,opts); System.assert(u1.isSuccess()); Account updatedRow=[SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Id=:s1.getId()]; System.assertEquals('Single Updated',updatedRow.Name); Object updateAccessObject=new Account(Id=s2.getId(),Name='Single Access Updated'); Database.SaveResult u2=Database.update(updateAccessObject,opts,AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(u2.isSuccess()); Account updatedAccessRow=[SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Id=:s2.getId()]; System.assertEquals('Single Access Updated',updatedAccessRow.Name); List<Object> updateRows=new List<Object>{new Account(Id=s3[0].getId(),Name='List A Updated'),new Account(Id=s3[1].getId(),Name='List B Updated')}; List<Database.SaveResult> u3=Database.update(updateRows,opts); System.assertEquals(2,u3.size()); System.assert(u3[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(u3[1].isSuccess()); List<Account> queried=[SELECT Id,Name FROM Account WHERE Id IN :new Set<Id>{s3[0].getId(),s3[1].getId()} ORDER BY Name]; System.assertEquals('List A Updated',queried[0].Name); System.assertEquals('List B Updated',queried[1].Name); List<Object> updateAccessRows=new List<Object>{new Account(Id=s4[0].getId(),Name='List Access A Updated'),new Account(Id=s4[1].getId(),Name='List Access B Updated')}; List<Database.SaveResult> u4=Database.update(updateAccessRows,opts,AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2,u4.size()); System.assert(u4[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(u4[1].isSuccess()); Schema.SObjectField externalField=Account.Other_Key__c; Object upsertObject=new Account(Name='Upserted',Other_Key__c='upsert-key'); Database.UpsertResult upserted=Database.upsert(upsertObject,externalField,false); System.assert(upserted.isSuccess()); System.assert(upserted.isCreated()); Account upsertRow=[SELECT Name,Other_Key__c FROM Account WHERE Id=:upserted.getId()]; System.assertEquals('Upserted',upsertRow.Name); System.assertEquals('upsert-key',upsertRow.Other_Key__c);

salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture exercises deterministic local DMLOptions and external-field upsert overloads only; it makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.
